skill.summary: High-performance containerized web scraper (Docker + Crawlee + Playwright). Use when user mentions any of these: 爬虫, 爬取, 抓取, 采集, 数据采集, 爬数据, 抓数据, 获取数据, scrape...

latestVersion.changelog: Fork of deep-scraper with Amazon-specific structured data extraction. Supports Best Sellers, search results, product detail pages with ASIN, price, rating, reviews, boughtPastMonth. Also includes YouTube transcript capture and generic page scraping.
